name: Personalized LED Stylus Pen
description: Enhance your branding with this unique 3-in-1 pen featuring a light-up logo mechanism. See your name in lights with our light up pen with name engraving. Simply click the top, and watch your logo illuminate.The engraving looks white when unlit and bright white when lit up. These pens are the best option to distribute at trade shows, marketing events, conferences, job fairs and more, Promote your business with a logo, brand name, website or phone number, great for branding and giveaways, promotion pen, office school pen, and for parties and events.This pen also includes a screen-touch tip and a ballpoint, making it a versatile, eye-catching tool for personalized promotion.
summary: 3 in 1 ballpoint pen, click-action light up mechanism, and screen stylus.
